seasonRead.headline: 2011–12: Rush offense provides the anchor
paragraphs: The 2011–12 model learned 6 forward styles. Rush / Transition Chance Creator led with 229 of 467 forwards (49.0%), followed by Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist at 19.3%.
Nearly one in two forwards land in Rush / Transition Chance Creator. The remaining 51.0% is spread across five other styles, so the model shows one strong anchor above a diversified support layer.

seasonRead.headline: 2011–12: No single defense identity breaks away
paragraphs: The 2011–12 model learned 6 defense styles. Puck-Pressure Transition Defenseman led with 81 of 243 defenders (33.3%), followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 27.2%.

Puck-Pressure Transition Defenseman leads at 33.3%, but Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman remains close at 27.2%. Six learned styles and a 16.0% share outside the top three make this a comparatively distributed within-season map.
